close_reason: Pre-filter same-type entries before containment check, eliminating the duplicate same_nc_variant call per iteration.
description: The intersection loop (lines 1290-1327) checks the condition 'same_nc_variant(&c.base, &n.base) && name_matches_subtree(...)' in two separate .iter().any() closures (lines 1292+1296-1299 and 1307-1308+1312-1315) plus an extra dedup check (1318-1321). The logic is correct but the code reads as four separate scanning passes over the same two lists. A cleaner structure: build a helper fn intersect_subtrees(current, new) -> GeneralSubtrees that expresses the RFC algorithm as a single documented pass. The current in-line expansion is hard to audit for RFC 5280 compliance.
title: intersection loop has duplicated same_nc_variant + name_matches_subtree call pairs
